reason: Raised for the modern era, which the dataset had almost entirely skipped. 69 entities began in the nineteenth century and 71 in the twentieth, worldwide, and the whole United States subtree was two rows -- itself and the Civil War -- while India had ten prime ministers listed and Britain none. 2,241 rows were authored and 215 dropped in reconciliation, taking the corpus from 3,301 to 5,507 at a cost of about 140 kB gzipped. Deleting the fabricated uncertainty gave some of that back.
